test.query: SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits_10m_single WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits_10m_single WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits_10m_single WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT UserID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY UserID, SearchPhrase ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT UserID, extract(minute FROM EventTime) AS m, SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY UserID, m, SearchPhrase ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT SearchEngineID, ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(Refresh), AVG(ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_10m_single WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID, ClientIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT WatchID, ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(Refresh), AVG(ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_10m_single WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY WatchID, ClientIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT WatchID, ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(Refresh), AVG(ResolutionWidth) FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY WatchID, ClientIP ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY URL ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT 1, URL, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY 1, URL ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT ClientIP, ClientIP - 1, ClientIP - 2, ClientIP - 3, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits_10m_single GROUP BY ClientIP, ClientIP - 1, ClientIP - 2, ClientIP - 3 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
